QuestInfo.name: Ericsson's Tale
QuestInfo.0: The Maple Administrator says that she has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: You should take the Maple Administrator's advice and talk to Ericsson, the brave adventurer in Ossyria. #bGo see Ericsson#k in Orbis. Don't forget the Maple Administrator's advice to bring #b1 Dry Treat#k as a gift for his pet.
QuestInfo.2: The Tale of Ericsson, the famous adventurer in Ossyria, is famous even amongst people who've never seen him. You brought a Dry Treat for his pet cat Nero and received his tale in return.

0.0: It's been tough collecting the tales I've requested, hasn't it? Let me inform you of one thing that might help you, #h0#. Maple World is filled with experienced heroes and they have more stories to tell than anyone else in the world.
0.1: Tales you acquire from them will be extremely valuable. So  how about finding and talking to #bEricsson#k in Orbis?

yes.0: Ericsson has a black cat named Nero, and I recommend you bring him 1 #bDry Treat#k as a gift for his pet.

no.0: It would be helpful to hear Ericsson's tales.

1.0: Arrrg! Oh, hey! I didn't see you there. What brings you here?\r\n#b#L0#I want to hear your tales.#l
1.1: Tales, huh? I don't have any to tell. I'm just enjoying life with my cat. Oh, Nero seems hungry.#b\r\n#L0#I brought a Dry Treat for your pet.#l
1.2: Thank you. Nero won't eat anything but Dry Treats. I want to reciprocate the kindness you have shown me... Do you just need to hear my tales?#b(Ericsson takes out a pencil and begins to scribble something.)#k\nI'm not a very articulate speaker and writing is much easier for me. I'm a little embarrassed, so please don't read it here.

yes.0: Go on, now. I have to take Nero for a walk soon.

item.0: Oh, Nero seems hungry. What do I do? My Nero is a picky eater and won't go near anything but Dry Treats.
